issues.message: Non-functional requirements (NFRs) are not explicitly defined. Missing performance targets (e.g., 2-second barcode scan response mentioned in acceptance criteria but no system-wide performance SLAs), security requirements (authentication, authorization, data encryption), and scalability requirements (concurrent users, data volume limits).

Web platform design is completely missing. Requirements specify both Web and Mobile platforms, but only mobile UI design is provided. Web interface design is required for store owners and managers who may prefer desktop access for reporting and management tasks.

No authentication/session management tables. The system requires user authentication (users table has password_hash) but lacks tables for session tokens, refresh tokens, or OAuth integration, which are critical for secure multi-platform access.

No offline mode or sync conflict resolution design. Real-time inventory systems must handle network interruptions gracefully. Missing designs for offline data entry, sync indicators, and conflict resolution when multiple users update the same product offline.

Missing comprehensive audit log table. While inventory_transactions logs inventory changes, there's no general audit table for tracking user actions (login, product edits, settings changes, alert configurations) which is critical for compliance and security.

Authentication and authorization requirements are not explicitly defined. No details on password policies, multi-factor authentication, role-based access control rules, or session management requirements.
Error handling and edge case screens are missing. No designs for network errors, barcode scan failures, concurrent update conflicts, or system maintenance modes. Critical for production readiness.

No soft delete implementation. Assumptions state actual deletion is used, but this prevents data recovery and historical reporting. Products, users, and sales data should support soft deletes with is_deleted flags and deleted_at timestamps.

Missing optimized indexes for reporting queries. The sales table lacks composite index on (created_at, user_id) which would significantly improve report generation performance for date-range filtered queries.
Data retention and archival policies are not defined. No specification for how long sales data, inventory transactions, or alerts should be retained, or when/how to archive historical data.

Real-time synchronization UI indicators are missing. Requirements mention WebSocket for real-time updates, but design lacks visual indicators showing sync status, connection state, or pending changes.

Product barcode uniqueness constraint may be too restrictive. Different suppliers may use the same barcode for different products. Consider composite unique constraint on (barcode, supplier_id) or add barcode_type field.

required_fixes: Add explicit Non-Functional Requirements section covering: performance SLAs (response times, throughput), security requirements (authentication methods, encryption standards, password policies), scalability targets (concurrent users, transaction volume), and availability requirements (uptime SLA, disaster recovery).

Create comprehensive Web platform UI design including responsive layouts for desktop/tablet, navigation patterns, and feature parity with mobile app. Prioritize reporting and management interfaces for larger screens.

Add authentication/session management tables to database schema: sessions table (id, user_id, token, refresh_token, expires_at, created_at, ip_address, user_agent) and password_reset_tokens table for secure password recovery.
Design offline mode functionality including: offline data entry screens, local storage strategy, sync status indicators, conflict resolution UI, and queue management for pending operations.
Add comprehensive audit_logs table to database: (id, user_id, action_type, table_name, record_id, old_values, new_values, ip_address, user_agent, created_at) for compliance and security tracking.

Define authentication and authorization requirements: password complexity rules, session timeout policies, role-based permissions matrix, multi-factor authentication options, and API authentication methods.
Create error handling screen designs: network error states, barcode scan failure recovery, concurrent update conflict resolution, validation error displays, and system maintenance notifications.

Implement soft delete pattern in database: add is_deleted (boolean) and deleted_at (timestamp) columns to products, users, categories, suppliers tables. Update queries to filter deleted records by default.
recommendations: Add composite indexes to optimize reporting queries: CREATE INDEX idx_sales_reporting ON sales(created_at DESC, user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_transactions_reporting ON inventory_transactions(created_at DESC, product_id, transaction_type); These will significantly improve dashboard and report generation performance.

Implement data retention and archival strategy: Define retention periods for each data type (e.g., sales data: 7 years for tax compliance, inventory transactions: 3 years, alerts: 90 days). Create archived_sales and archived_inventory_transactions tables for historical data with automated archival jobs.

Add real-time sync status indicators to all screens: Connection status badge in navigation bar, pending changes counter, last sync timestamp, and manual sync trigger button. Use color coding (green: synced, yellow: syncing, red: offline) for immediate user feedback.

Enhance barcode handling flexibility: Add barcode_type field (UPC, EAN, QR, etc.) to products table and support multiple barcodes per product through product_barcodes junction table. This accommodates products with multiple barcode formats or supplier-specific codes.

Implement progressive web app (PWA) features for web platform: Service workers for offline functionality, push notifications for alerts, installable web app, and responsive design that works across desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers. This provides web platform parity with native mobile features.

Add rate limiting and API throttling specifications: Define request rate limits per user role, implement exponential backoff for failed requests, and add API usage monitoring. This prevents system abuse and ensures fair resource allocation during high-traffic periods.
